description: Chart 16 — Where venues last, mapped. Two-year survival of the July 2023 liquor-licence cohort by SA2 (still licensed July 2025), on the same equal-area projection of Victoria as the other choropleths. Colour carries survival; it is high and fairly even statewide (mostly 85–95%), with no obvious 'near the city / near transport' advantage — the spatial echo of charts 14 and 15. SA2s with fewer than 5 cohort venues are left ungraded (grey) to avoid noisy rates. Survival is a licence-presence proxy; association only. Data: chart_sa2_survival.csv joined to sa2_summary_simplified.topojson on sa2_code_2021.

title.text: Venues last across most of Victoria — city or country
title.subtitle: Two-year survival of 2023 venues by SA2. Grey = fewer than 5 venues (rate too noisy to show).
